title: Move the remaining client-test fakes onto tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js (lin-3833 first)
description:
Follow-up to LIN-4252. The shared fake DOM now lives at tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js, and lin-4010 and lin-4242 use it. 18 other client-test files still hand-write a makeContainer or a FakeNode/parseHtml (grep -rlE "function makeContainer|const makeContainer|class FakeNode|function parseHtml" tests/unit/\*.test.js, excluding lin-4010). Move them onto the shared fake one at a time, lin-3833-run-control first: its slotContainer at line \~358 is the closest model of what LIN-4246 needs. Each move keeps its test names and counts, and any test that goes red on a real path is reported as a finding rather than loosened.
Removing the container.querySelector guards and else-render fallbacks in public/prompt-section.js is a separate production change and stays out of this follow-up.

comments.body: Priority: lowest. Test-only tidy with no production effect and no recurring risk; its value is making LIN-4246-style repaint witnesses cheap in each file as it is touched. Type label: Improvement (nearest in the catalog; no test-infra label exists). LIN-4252 merged as d234b94a; the shared fake now models `type` and `checked` too.

issue.title: Client unit tests get one fake DOM that can repaint (tidy first, before LIN-4246)
